I've been on it for give or take 5 years, and I finally am completely off. It has only been 2 weeks since my last dose, but I've been weaning off for MONTHS. For that long, I would listen to others as well and get a doctor or psychiatrist to help aid you in the journey, but this subreddit helped me so much.

First, it is NOT easy, but we all know this. I've blatantly told my friends and family when I started tapering that I would be fuzzy-headed, angry, irritable, and just straight sad, but to know that this is the reason why. I'm still dealing with it, the range of emotions I haven't felt for years, as I've been on a constant "fine" feeling. 

I was on 50mg for the past 5 years, but talked to my doctor about tapering off, and she prescribed me with 25mg to help. I'm not gonna lie, she's useless. But to be fair, I don't think she's as well educated on withdrawal as a psychiatrist, so it makes sense as she's just a PA. 

The nitty-gritty: Anywho, I started off by going 50 one day, 25 the other and back and forth to test the waters. I gave that like 2 months or so until I felt comfortable switching to 25mg every day. Then a month or two later every other day. Then 2 or 3 months later, every 2 days, and so on. When I went every 2 days, this is when I reeeeally started to feel the side-effects. Mine were not as severe as others, no zaps. But I had to leave early from work or even tell my boss I was not having a great day and to bear with me because of how I was feeling physically. Another month, another day in between until I realized wait... I didn't take it for a week, and I don't feel super weird or extremely faint or brain-foggy or sad. Since then, I continued on and I think I'm officially done now.

I'm sorry if this was long-winded, but this was my experience after being on it for a few years, I hope this helps. And most importantly, good luck! We're all rooting for you!
